subject: Problem with Install of shiny package on server

messages.author: aa1e1e9f24c1d780
messages.subject: Problem with Install of shiny package on server
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to install the 'shiny' package with this command on Ubuntu 18.04 server:-

sudo su - \ -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny',repos='https://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

but I keep getting:-

No passwd entry for user ' -c'

Has anyone else got this?

Thanks

messages.author: 6a288128bce8283d
messages.subject: Re: Problem with Install of shiny package on server
parts:
This is the command I'm using, which works fine:

sudo su --c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='https://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

Looks like the backslash before the c is causing the issue in your case.
